clauses.title: Liability of product service provider
clauses.text: 85. A product service provider shall be liable in a product liability action, if— (a) the service provided by him was faulty or imperfect or deficient or inadequate in quality, nature or manner of performance which is required to be provided by or under any law for the time being in force, or pursuant to any contract or otherwise; or (b) there was an act of omission or commission or negligence or conscious withholding any information which caused harm; or (c) the service provider did not issue adequate instructions or warnings to prevent any harm; or (d) the service did not conform to express warranty or the terms and conditions of the contract.

# Complaint: MakeMyTrip took Rs 12,000 for a hotel booking that the hotel says it n — [BOOKING / REFERENCE NUMBER]

```
To,
Company grievance contact
MakeMyTrip

Date: 09 October 2026

Subject: Complaint: MakeMyTrip took Rs 12,000 for a hotel booking that the hotel says it n — [BOOKING / REFERENCE NUMBER]

Dear Sir/Madam,

I am writing to formally complain about your product/service (reference [BOOKING / REFERENCE NUMBER], dated [DATE], amount ₹12000).

What happened: MakeMyTrip took Rs 12,000 for a hotel booking that the hotel says it never received.

This is contrary to the consumer-protection rules that apply to you, including: Definitions [C1]; Definitions [C2]; Liability of product service provider [C3].

I request: [REMEDY - e.g. full refund / replacement / reversal].

Please acknowledge this complaint and resolve it within 30 days. If it is not resolved, I will escalate it to National Consumer Helpline (NCH).

[YOUR NAME]

```

## If there's no reply
1. **Company grievance contact** (email / grievance page) — First. Complain in writing and keep proof.
2. **National Consumer Helpline (NCH)** (portal / phone / WhatsApp) — If the company does not resolve it. https://consumerhelpline.gov.in · 1915 · WhatsApp 8800001915
3. **District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission** (online filing (e-Jagriti)) — File within two years of the cause of action. https://e-jagriti.gov.in

_Information, not legal advice._
